reasoning: On the season so far the Trail Blazers are the stronger team; with home court the Trail Blazers start about 11 points better, in a game of about 225 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Trail Blazers.
The mental side leans about 0 points towards the Trail Blazers.
Bottom line: the Trail Blazers win 80 times in 100, by about 12; most games like this end between 196 and 245 total points.

analyst.text: Both teams are 2-1 in West Group C, so this is effectively a Cup elimination game, and Golden State also need help from Lakers-Spurs. The Warriors are again without Stephen Curry (oblique, re-evaluated Friday), Jimmy Butler, Moses Moody and Kristaps Porzingis, who is away from the team and expected to be traded. Portland are missing Ja Morant and Shaedon Sharpe but are at home. The news leans Portland.
